about: Claude subscription plans, for allyoucaneat (plan fit). Monthly list prices in USD, billed monthly, as last known: check claude.com/pricing before you change plan, and add or override plans (a team seat, a negotiated price) by id in ~/.tokenomics/plans.json. Subscriptions are not unlimited: each has usage limits that reset every few hours and weekly, so a price below your pay-as-you-go spend is a candidate, not a promise. kind: metered (pay per token at API prices) or subscription.
